chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated from Ibn Abi Umayr, from al-'Ala', from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the Imams (peace be upon him), who said:
I asked him about a slave who falsely accuses a free man, he said: He is flogged with the prescribed punishment.
ai.seo_question: What is the punishment for a slave who falsely accuses a free man of adultery?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Istibsar clarifies that a slave (abd) accused of qadhf against a free man (hur) receives the standard hadd punishment of eighty lashes, rather than the reduced fifty lashes often cited for slaves in other contexts. This ruling underscores the principle of equality in penal execution between slaves and free men in this specific legal scenario, as transmitted through the chain of Ibn Abi Umayr and al-Ala'.
